previous_disclosures.summary: The application networking and security software portfolio delivers zero-trust lateral security and load balancing solutions to combat malware and ransomware, featuring distributed architectures, deep visibility, and plug-and-play operations. Key capabilities include the Lateral Security Firewall, which enables access control and isolates sensitive applications, and Advanced Threat Prevention, which integrates multiple detection technologies to identify lateral threat movement and ransomware campaigns.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD Solarflare offers low-latency networking solutions using hardware adapters and Onload libraries, serving as the preferred solution for capital markets high-performance applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose low-latency networking solutions as key product offerings, but they target different market segments. AVGO focuses on application-level load balancing to simplify DevOps workflows and enhance availability ('deliver load balancing at the speed of applications'), whereas AMD's Solarflare portfolio focuses on hardware-level high-performance networking for specific capital markets applications ('preferred networking solution for capital markets').

sentences.text: • Advanced Load Balancing: This solution simplifies and accelerates application deployments and enhances application availability and resiliency to deliver load balancing at the speed of applications, allowing customers to leverage built-in automation to deploy load balancing as code as part of DevOps workflows for rapid infrastructure roll out.
The AMD Solarflare™ portfolio offers a comprehensive low latency networking solution that combines hardware adapters with the Onload™ family of user space networking libraries.
AMD Solarflare products are the preferred networking solution for capital markets, enabling customers to develop a wide range of high-performance applications across the entire trading ecosystem.
